to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Total number of questions — 20
63
Achievement levels of KV students
*201. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Kendriya Vidyalaya
Sangathan has conducted any survey of the
achievement levels of its students in English,
Maths, Science and SST for classes VII
and VIII;
(b) if so, the results thereof and the steps
taken to further augment the achievement
levels;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Kendriya Vidyalaya, INA
Colony has taken up any such quality
assessment of its students for class VIII;
(e) if so, the results thereof; and
(f) if not, by when the Kendriya
Vidyalaya Sangathan intends to initiate it?
 Power to all by 2012
*202. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to provide power to all by
2012;
(b) if so, what is the estimate of total
power requirement of each State and UT in
2012, the sources of supply and their
capacities to provide power;
(c) what directions have been given to
State Electricity Boards and power
distributing agencies to ensure that
transmission lines are ready in time to
supply power available for consumers; and
(d) the authority designated to co-
ordinate for ensuring planned construction
and commencement of production,
distribution of power to distributing
agencies and transmission to consumers?
 Gas required by the power sector
*203. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI VIRENDRA BHATIA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) the quantum of gas being made
available to the power sector from the
exploration of D6 block of KG basin;

64
(b) the approximate requirement of gas
for the power sector; and
(c) whether the Ministry had taken up
the matter with the concerned Ministries
for allocation of natural gas for
implementing its projects and if so, the
outcome thereof?
 Minority educational institutions
*204. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether many States have minority
educational institutions;
(b) if so, the number of educational
institutions including schools, colleges,
professional colleges and self-financing
professional colleges of various categories
that had applied and have been granted
minority status during the last three years,
year-wise, category-wise and State-wise;
(c) the total number of students and the
students of various minority communities
enrolled in above educational institutions
during that period, year-wise, category-
wise, State-wise and institution-wise;and
(d) the number of the above educational
institutions run by minority communities
during that period, category-wise,
community-wise, State-wise and
year-wise?
 Indo-US power agreement
*205. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether any agreement in the power
sector has been signed during his recent
U.S. visit;
(b) if so, to what extent the agreement
is likely to help in improving the sagging
power situation in the country;
(c) whether any power plants by the
American companies are proposed to be
set up in the country, as per the agreement;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
 Status of houses under Bhakra
Management Board
*206. SHRI TARLOCHAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of Government houses in
the Nangal township which are now under
the control of the Bhakra Management
Board, category-wise;
(b) the number of occupied houses and
those lying vacant and the period for which
they have been vacant;
(c) the condition of these houses; and
(d) whether there is any policy to save
these houses and, since Government
Officials demand is not there, whether these
could be given on rent to private persons?
 Question patterns in written tests
*207. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether NCERT has suggested re-
vamping the question patterns in written
tests, with more emphasis on short-
answer-type and multiple-choice
questions;
(b) whether NCERT has discussed the
matter with the Education Boards in the
country;
(c) the names of the Boards with which
NCERT has held discussions; and
(d) the reaction of each of the Boards
regarding the matter?

to take in the wake of Hon'ble Prime

 Generation of tidal energy
1519. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to generate
tidal energy in the country;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any scheme for generating
affordable energy from sea waves; and
(c) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the status of the project?
 Workers in food processing industries
†1520. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the approximate number of workers
working in the food processing industries
in the country, at present;
(b) the number of those, out of the
above, who are working in the unorganised
sector; and
(c) what has been the overall growth
rate of this industry during the current year?
 Upgradation of Cochin University
1521. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to upgrade the Cochin University of Science
and Technology into an institute of national
importance;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the action taken in this regard; and
(d) the benefits that would accrue
including the financial assistance, by
upgrading the status of the University?
 Books on sex education
†1522. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

351
intend to effect some changes in the books
on sex education prescribed in the schools
throughout the country with the help of
UNESCO/UNO;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) if not, the details thereof; and
(d) the objectives behind imposing sex
education on the students despite strong
opposition to it throughout the country?
 Schools with pucca buildings in
Jharkhand
1523. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of primary, middle and
secondary schools in Jharkhand that do not
have pucca buildings;
(b) the number of schools that have a
teacher for each class and how many
schools have teachers who have to teach in
more than one classes;
(c) the figures of such schools with the
teacher teaching classes 2, 3, 4 and 5 all
alone and by when the teacher and the
classroom ratio would be reduced to 1:1;
and
(d) in what manner Government
propose to improve the situation?
 Increasing seats in higher education
1524. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to increase
the seats in higher technical institutions like
Indian Institutes of Technology, Indian
Institutes of Management, etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Financial outlay for higher and
technical education
1525. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Education Committee on
Financing of Higher and Technical
Education has recommended that 6 per cent
of GDP should be set aside for education,
of which one per cent should be earmarked
for higher education and 0.5 per cent for
technical education;
(b) whether the Working Group has also
suggested that the total financial outlay for
this sector during the Eleventh Five Year
Plan should be Rs. 39,402.50 crore,
compared to the Tenth Five Year Plan
allocation of Rs. 4,700 crore;
(c) if so, whether Government have
agreed to these suggestions; and
(d) by when a final decision, in this
regard is likely to be taken?
 Absence of head of institutions
1526. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Institute of Advanced Studies, Mussouri,
the Indian Institute of Management,
Lucknow, The Indian Institute of
Management, Kolkata, the National School
of Drama and the Council for Scientific and
Industrial Research are without the head of
institutions;
(b) if so, for how long these institutions
have been running without heads;

352
(c) whether there are any other major
institutions without the top managerial
personnel; and
(d) the reasons and constraints in
appointing the heads of the institutions
promptly without delay?
 Applications for setting up of foreign
universities
1527. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of HUMAN

(a) whether Government have received
a number of applications for establishment
of foreign univer
